question: Question: Find the name of the department that offers the largest number of credits of all classes.
gold: SELECT T3.dept_name FROM course AS T1 JOIN CLASS AS T2 ON T1.crs_code  =  T2.crs_code JOIN department AS T3 ON T1.dept_code  =  T3.dept_code GROUP BY T1.dept_code ORDER BY sum(T1.crs_credit) DESC LIMIT 1
completion:
```sql
WITH CLASS_Credits AS (
    SELECT CLASS_CODE, COUNT(*) AS count
    FROM CLASS
    GROUP BY CLASS_CODE
),
CLASS_CreditsMax AS (
    SELECT MAX(count) AS max_count
    FROM CLASS_Credits
)
SELECT DEPT_CODE, DEPT_NAME
FROM DEPARTMENT
WHERE DEPT_CODE IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT DEPT_CODE
    FROM CLASS_Credits
    GROUP BY DEPT_CODE
    HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(count) FROM CLASS_Credits)
);
